exposure: timing of admission to labor units
cohort: 216 low-risk, nulliparous women with spontaneous labor onset at term gestation
finding: Low-risk nulliparous women with regular, spontaneous uterine contractions who are admitted to labor units before active labor onset are more likely to receive oxytocin and give birth via cesarean.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women admitted to labor units before active labor onset had a higher likelihood of cesarean birth.
